UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores the authenticated user's cognitive training profile, XP, streak, psychology law mastery, game high scores, and preferences.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

avatar.description: URL of the user's profile avatar.

title.description: Cognitive rank title earned by the user.

lastActiveDate.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of last activity.

totalGames.description: Total number of cognitive mini-games played.

totalQuizzes.description: Total number of rapid quizzes completed.

quizPoints.description: Cumulative points earned from rapid quizzes.

lawsMastered.description: List of mastered psychology law IDs (bounded to max 50).

lawMasteryMap.description: Map of psychology law ID to mastery percentage (0-100).

bookmarks.description: List of bookmarked psychology law IDs (bounded to max 50).

gameHighScores.description: Map of game ID to highest score achieved.

unlockedBadges.description: List of unlocked achievement badge IDs (bounded to max 50).

selectedGoals.description: List of selected cognitive training goals (bounded to max 20).

hasCompletedOnboarding.description: Whether the user has completed initial onboarding.

isDailyChallengeCompleted.description: Whether the daily cognitive challenge is completed today.

completedGames.description: List of IDs of completed mini-games.

gameCompletionCount.description: Map of mini-game ID to completion counts.

stats.description: Five-dimensional cognitive capability scores (memory, attention, reasoning, knowledge, decision).

weeklyActivity.description: 7-day rolling activity log entries (bounded to max 14).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

CognitiveJournal.title: CognitiveJournal
CognitiveJournal.description: Structured daily cognitive journal log recording emotional state, cognitive distortions, metacognitive insights, and reframing exercises.

id.description: Unique identifier of the journal entry.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the journal entry owner.

date.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of the entry.

title.description: Title or headline of the journal insight.

templateType.description: Template archetype used (e.g. cbt-restructure, flow-reflection, emotional-decentering, decision-debiasing, free-insight).

emotion.description: Structured daily emotional state payload including primary emotion, intensity, and valence.

relatedLawId.description: Optional psychology law ID attached to the entry.

structuredData.description: Structured key-value response mapping for the selected template.

tags.description: Bounded array of category tags for filtering (up to 10 items).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last updated.

GameLeaderboardEntry.title: GameLeaderboardEntry
GameLeaderboardEntry.description: Public daily leaderboard record storing high scores, accuracies, and ranks achieved in cognitive training games.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID or player ID of the user.

userLevel.description: Current cognitive level of the player (1-1000).

gameId.description: ID of the specific cognitive game or 'all' for daily total.

gameName.description: Display name of the cognitive game.

score.description: Score achieved in the game or total daily score.

date.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) for daily ranking partitioning.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when score was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when score was last updated.

FocusSessionBookmark.title: FocusSessionBookmark
FocusSessionBookmark.description: Bookmarked focus audio session timestamp and exact stereo binaural/nature soundscape configuration owned strictly by the user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the bookmark owner.

label.description: User-provided or default title describing the bookmarked ambient segment.

timestampSec.description: Session elapsed timestamp in seconds (0 to 86400).

binauralPresetId.description: Active binaural brainwave band preset ID.

naturePresetId.description: Active procedural nature soundscape preset ID.

beatHz.description: Binaural beat difference frequency in Hz (4 to 45).

carrierHz.description: Left-ear carrier base frequency in Hz (100 to 320).

binauralMix.description: Normalized binaural layer gain mix (0 to 1).

natureMix.description: Normalized nature soundscape layer gain mix (0 to 1).

timerDurationSec.description: Configured session timer duration in seconds (0 for continuous, up to 14400).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the bookmark was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was last updated.

BrainGymSession.title: BrainGymSession
BrainGymSession.description: Persisted memory or reaction time training session record completed in the Brain Gym module, owned strictly by {userId}.

id.description: Unique identifier of the Brain Gym training session.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the session owner.

gameId.description: Brain Gym exercise ID (nback-sequence, chrono-span, reflex-pulse, go-nogo-gate).

gameTitle.description: Human-readable title of the Brain Gym exercise.

score.description: Final computed score achieved in the session (0 to 1000000).

avgReactionMs.description: Average reaction latency in milliseconds (0 to 10000).

bestReactionMs.description: Fastest valid reaction latency in milliseconds (0 to 10000).

maxSpan.description: Maximum working-memory span or N-back level achieved (0 to 32).

roundsCompleted.description: Number of rounds or stimulus trials completed (0 to 200).

xpEarned.description: Experience points awarded for the session (0 to 500).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the session was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was written.

LawMarginaliaNote.title: LawMarginaliaNote
LawMarginaliaNote.description: Handwritten-style or voice-dictated marginalia annotation attached directly to a specific page of a psychological law in the book reader, owned strictly by {userId}.

id.description: Unique identifier of the marginalia note.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note owner.

lawId.description: Psychology law identifier associated with this marginalia note.

pageIndex.description: Zero-based book reader page index (0 to 11).

content.description: Typed or voice-dictated marginalia annotation text.

inkColor.description: Archival fountain-pen ink color preset (sepia, crimson, indigo, or emerald).

handwritingStyle.description: Calligraphic handwriting typeface preset (cursive, running, or archival).

anchorZone.description: Page margin placement zone (top-margin, side-margin, or bottom-margin).

tiltDeg.description: Natural handwritten micro-tilt angle in degrees (-5 to 5).

sourceMode.description: Input method used to author the note (typed or dictated).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the marginalia note was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the marginalia note was last updated.

LawPageBookmark.title: LawPageBookmark
LawPageBookmark.description: Reading progress marker or specific book page bookmark for a psychology law in the book reader, owned strictly by {userId}.

id.description: Unique identifier of the law page bookmark (or deterministic prog_{lawId} for reading progress).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the bookmark owner.

lawId.description: Psychology law identifier associated with this page bookmark.

lawNameZh.description: Chinese display title of the bookmarked psychology law.

lawNameEn.description: English display title of the bookmarked psychology law.

categoryZh.description: Category label of the bookmarked law.

pageIndex.description: Zero-based book reader page index (0 to 11).

pageTitle.description: Spread or chapter title label for the bookmarked page.

bookmarkKind.description: Distinguishes continuous reading progress ('progress') from specific pinned pages ('page-pin').

note.description: Optional short reader note describing why this page was bookmarked.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the page bookmark was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the page bookmark was last updated.

LawReviewSchedule.title: LawReviewSchedule
LawReviewSchedule.description: Spaced repetition review schedule (SM-2) for a favorited psychology law, owned strictly by {userId}.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the review schedule owner.

lawNameZh.description: Chinese display title of the psychology law.

lawNameEn.description: English display title of the psychology law.

categoryZh.description: Category label of the psychology law.

easeFactor.description: SM-2 ease factor bounded between 1.3 and 3.5.

intervalDays.description: Current spaced repetition interval in days (0 to 3650).

totalReviews.description: Cumulative completed reviews for this law (0 to 5000).

lastRating.description: Most recent recall quality rating (none, again, hard, good, easy).

nextReviewAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds for the next scheduled review.

lastReviewedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last completed review (0 if never reviewed).

snoozedUntilMs.description: Epoch milliseconds until notifications are snoozed (0 if not snoozed).

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether optimal-interval reminders are enabled for this law.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the schedule was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the schedule was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and cognitive training progress document owned strictly by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/cognitiveJournals/{journ.description: Private structured cognitive journal logs owned strictly by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/focusSessionBookmarks/{b.description: Private focus audio session timestamp bookmarks owned strictly by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/brainGymSessions/{sessio.description: Private Brain Gym memory and reaction-time training session logs owned strictly by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/lawMarginalia/{noteId}.description: Private handwritten-style book marginalia notes on psychological law pages owned strictly by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/lawPageBookmarks/{bookma.description: Private reading progress markers and specific book page bookmarks for psychological laws owned strictly by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/lawReviewSchedules/{lawI.description: Private spaced repetition review schedules for favorited psychological laws owned strictly by {userId}.

/gameLeaderboards/{scoreId}.description: Daily cognitive training game leaderboard scores partitioned by date for real-time multiplayer competition.
